messages:
Tom (Sales): hey finance team — need quick approval for a custom pricing ask from Orchid Therapeutics. They want Dedicated reserved capacity + private deployment, 12mo commit, asking for 20% off list. Can we move on this by EOW?
Aisha (Finance): quick Q — what's the committed ARR and the current list we're discounting from?
Tom (Sales): committed spend = $720k ARR (60k/mo). List price we'd charge is $60k/mo. They're signing 12 months + a public case study and logo + a pilot POC.
Priya (Acct Exec): they also need a clause for data residency and a 45-day invoice net term. Legal will want to review.
Jorge (FP&A): 20% off $720k -> $576k. That's a $144k yearly concession. Margin impact? Assuming cost run-rate of ~$22k/mo for the Dedicated pool -> cost 264k/yr. Gross margin would drop from ~63% to ~54% after concession.
Aisha (Finance): thanks Jorge. Need the commercial rationale documented: strategic reference, uplift potential, risk of losing to competitor. Can Sales add that here?
Tom (Sales): rationale: 1) Strategic pharma customer, global rollout planned, potential expansion to Dedicated across 3 products over 24 months. 2) Competitive push — another vendor offered 15% + credits. 3) Case study + pilot incentivizes earlier buy-in.
Aisha (Finance): ok. Proposed approvals: Finance lead sign-off for up to 15% discount, >15% needs FP&A + CFO sign-off. Also require AR to accept 45-day net with pre-pay options.
Priya (Acct Exec): timeline: they need signed SOW by next Thu. Can we get fast-track review?
Dana (CFO): tagging in. I can approve up to 18% for strategic deals with clear expansion signals and a signed case study + exec intro. We should cap contractual custom concessions to 18% and require payment SLA (net 30 preferred).
Jorge (FP&A): if CFO approves 18%, the blended ARR would be $590.4k (after 18% off). Concession = $129.6k. Still ok vs. LTV expectations? We should record this as a negotiated concession in forecast.
Aisha (Finance): action items: 1) Tom/Priya to upload the customer justification doc and competition proof. 2) Sales to confirm whether case study and exec intro are contractual deliverables. 3) Billing team to note 45-day net request.
Tom (Sales): uploading rationale doc now. Also confirmed they will commit to a 12mo auto-renew with 60 days' notice for non-renewal. Case study: pilot results + marketing window 90 days post-launch, exec intro included.
billing-bot: automated note — customer Orchid Therapeutics already has pending invoice INV-2026-0041 for trial usage; no outstanding delinquencies.
Aisha (Finance): thanks. Given the expansion signals and case study, I provisionally approve 15% from Finance. Dana, can you confirm final sign-off for up to 18%?
Dana (CFO): I'll sign off at 18% provided Legal adds a clause that promotional/public assets are deliverables and AR approves the net terms. Also want an initial 25% upfront payment on the first invoice.
Priya (Acct Exec): customer accepts 25% upfront and net 45 on remainder to match their AP cycles. They prefer 45 vs 30.
Jorge (FP&A): net 45 increases DSO risk. If CFO requires 25% upfront we mitigate ~25% of credit exposure. That seems acceptable.
Aisha (Finance): final: approve 18% discount, require 25% upfront, remainder net 45, case study & exec intro as contract deliverables, legal to review T&Cs. I'll create the approval note and tag contracting.
Tom (Sales): amazing — will route to deal desk and contracting now. Thanks all :tada:
Priya (Acct Exec): routing to Legal & Contracts, will update once signed.
Tom (Sales): will capture the final numbers in Salesforce and mark as "Approved - Financial Exception".
Aisha (Finance): please attach signed SOW and final invoice schedule here once complete. Closing thread for approvals but leave open for billing handoff. :white_check_mark:
